description: One business's public website on this Frappe site. Requests on its domains see only its pages: / is its home page, /<path> is the page routed <route prefix>/<path>, and every other site's prefix is a 404. Shared routes (assets, API, login, webshop cart) pass through.

fields.description: The business this website belongs to.
fields.label: Company

fields.description: First route segment this site's pages live under: the primary domain with its dots as hyphens, e.g. zephyrex-ca: the page routed zephyrex-ca/about serves zephyrex.ca/about.
fields.label: Route Prefix

fields.description: Route (under the prefix) of the page served at /.
fields.label: Home Route

fields.description: Name of the Webshop Store (frappe-webshop fork) that sells on this site, if any.
fields.label: Webshop Store

fields.description: Name of the Blog Category (blog app) this site publishes, if any. Its posts serve at /<post route> and / serves the category's listing instead of the home route.
fields.label: Blog Category

fields.description: Record page views in Frappe (Web Page View, stamped with this site). Cookieless; stored in this ERP.
fields.label: Frappe View Tracking

fields.description: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID (G-XXXXXXXXXX). Adds the Google tag to every page of this site.
fields.label: GA4 Measurement ID

fields.description: Matomo base URL (https://…/). With a Site ID, adds the Matomo tracker to every page of this site.
fields.label: Matomo URL

name: Public Site
